title: setup hook keeps every key and group of the user's file in place and appends the JITSO groups after the user's
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup hook, defect N-17): jitso registers its guard in the project's .claude/settings.json without clobbering anything
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-17, setup hook). A canonical 2-space file with `$schema`, `permissions`, a user `Bash` group under `hooks.PreToolUse`, `hooks.Stop` and `env` last. The result keeps every user key and group where it was; the three JITSO PreToolUse groups follow the user's PreToolUse group, and `SessionEnd` is added at the end of `hooks`, before `env`. Since N-25 the guard also has a third PreToolUse group, `Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit`.
